name: Biceps Curl

instructions.description: Stand with dumbbells at the sides and palms facing forward.
Keep the upper arms close to the torso.
Bend the elbows to raise the weights without swinging.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Biceps Curl — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Biceps Curl — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Keep the upper arms relatively still.
